title: Climate policy and energy transitions
description: I analyse how policy interventions interact with the evolution of energy systems, with particular attention to whether policy has measurably accelerated transitions.

title: Political acceleration
description: My doctoral research examined historical interventions in the G7 and the EU and how they changed the pace and direction of energy transitions.

title: Targets, ambition, and delivery
description: I study the relationship between long-term climate targets, near-term renewable ambitions, and realized deployment, including how expectations compare with historically observed rates of change.
